title: Assign Workers to Jobs
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 500 workers, n ≤ 500 jobs; worker i can do job j iff edge (i, j) exists. Maximize the number of filled jobs.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** Greedy: everyone takes their first available job

**B)** Kruskal spanning tree on workers

**C)** Bipartite matching with augmenting paths (Kuhn / Hopcroft-Karp)

**D)** Prefix sums over workers

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Bipartite structure + maximize assignments = matching. Greedy fails the classic two-way conflict; augmenting paths fix it.
